_about: Inputs and outputs of JBL Headphones 5.37.10's libpersonifiAlgorithm.so calCompensation (mode 3), run in an emulator outside the repo on synthetic thresholds (2026-11-24): each case's bands as [type, frequency, dB] for the left and right ear, the master gain and the twelve output bands as [type, gain, frequency, q] for each ear. JblPersonifiTest reproduces every one. The library's code is not in the repo.
